description.text: Charming, move-in ready 2-bed Magnolia townhome offering the perfect condo alternative with NO HOA dues! Filled with natural light and featuring hardwood floors, an updated kitchen with quartz counters & abundant storage, upgraded bath with double sinks, full-size W/D, newer furnace & tankless water heater. Enjoy a private yard perfect for entertaining, views over Magnolia & easy parking at your door. Quiet neighborhood just moments from Magnolia Village, Discovery Park, shops, dining, Farmers Market & recreation. Easy access to Queen Anne, Ballard, Fremont, downtown & the waterfront!
